newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour's Brown pledges tough line on spending.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour's Brown pledges tough line on spending.

text.p: UK opposition Labour Party finance spokesman Gordon Brown pledged "iron discipline" on public spending and said there would be no unsustainable dashes for growth.

"The reason the Labour Party shows iron discipline in our approach to public spending is that every pound that is inefficiently spent is a pound denied to our frontline public services," Brown said on Monday in a speech prepared for delivery at the Labour Party's annual conference in Blackpool.
Brown pledged "costed, hard-headed and radical policies for stability, employment, educational opportunity and enterprise" and said there would be no unsustainable dashes for growth.

"In the economy of new Britain, under Labour, there will be no room for boardroom excesses which waste national resources, no room for monopolies and cartels which restrict competition, no place for City cliques whose restrictive practices deny opportunity," Brown said.
